text_block_list.name: Pandora & Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthdaay~~! I wish you a very happy 
birthday~~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you two. That's quite an 
'ad-mirable' attitude!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That secret elixir in the shiny gold vial 
you sent— you had a high-ranking witch 
brew it, didn't you? I really like the 
sweet scent!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it like, super lovely perfume~? I 
picked the bottle, and Kawakami-senpai 
chose the scent♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My blood boils with refreshing energy! It 
is truly a spicy princess flavor!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
They say sweet scents totally captivate 
everyone☆ You were looking for something 
like that, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll enchant them with this scent and 
expand my familiar ranks! I've already 
infused this wand with it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"You who stand by the demonic realm, obey 
me! Ran-ran☆Ranunculus~~!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my goodness~~! Such a lovely fragrance 
from the wand! The atmosphere has become 
completely dazzling in a flash!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh wow... That smells so amazing~â Let 
me smell more~! Lady Sweep~~â¡

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! A total success! The day the whole 
academy becomes my familiars is just 
around the corner!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
First, we deal with that cheeky Orfevre! 
Come on, everyone, follow me!
